  <v-card class="tile-start-stop" :style="tileStyle" @click="toggle">
    <v-icon size="28" :color="running ? '#00e676' : '#ff1744'">
      {{ running ? 'mdi-play-circle' : 'mdi-stop-circle' }}
    </v-icon>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
  export default {
  data() { return { running: false } },
  computed: {
    tileStyle() {
return {
        backgroundColor: this.running ? '#1b5e20' : '#424242',
        border: this.running ? '2px solid #333' : '2px solid #ffd600'
      };
    }
  },
  watch: {
    msg(m) {
if (!m || m.payload === undefined) return;
this.running = m.payload === true || m.payload === 'true' || m.payload === 1;
    }
  },
  methods: {
    toggle() {
this.running = !this.running;
this.send({ payload: this.running });
    }
  }
}
</script>

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 0.3s;

format:
<style>
/* AIoT Secure-Boot page: slim ONLY the diagnostics banner group.
   EVERY rule is qualified with the unique class .aiot-sb-banner, which ONLY our
   banner group carries -> other demos' panels are unaffected even though this
   site:style loads dashboard-wide. Trims the D2 card padding + the site red glow. */
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-banner { padding: 0 6px !important; min-height: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
/* One-screen fit: the page grid sits a few px over the 800x480 panel, causing a
   tiny scrollbar. Shave the grid's own vertical padding + row-gap (8px each ->
   small) to reclaim just enough. Scoped via :has to ONLY our Secure-Boot page,
   so Harald's other pages keep their default spacing. Tunable if still off. */
.nrdb-layout--grid:has(.aiot-sb-banner) { padding-top: 2px !important; padding-bottom: 2px !important; row-gap: 4px !important; }
/* Campaigns (FOTA) section: slight pink tint. The grey is painted by the inner
   Vuetify .v-card (rgb 42,42,62), NOT the group div, so target that card. */
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-campaigns .v-card { background-color: #3a2a34 !important; }
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-banner .v-card-text,
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-banner .nrdb-ui-group-content { padding-top: 0 !important; padding-bottom: 0 !important; }
/* Device selector: collapse the card padding to ~2px so the dropdown fills
   the box and can use a larger font. Scoped to .aiot-sb-dev only. */
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-dev { padding: 2px !important; }
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-dev .v-card,
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-dev .v-card-text,
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-dev .nrdb-ui-group-content { padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
.nrdb-ui-group.aiot-sb-dev .nrdb-ui-widget { height: 100% !important; }
</style>
